messages:
Alex: Quick experiment proposal — DP RSVP + no-show mitigation. Thinking an A/B test with 3 invite templates + control, and a 72h slot hold policy with auto-reminders. Thoughts?

Marta: Love it. Can we tie commitment to a 2-week onboarding slot (fixed) so CS can batch handoffs? :thumbsup:

Sam: Curious about incentives — credits vs private onboarding session? which reduces dropouts more?

Jin: Automation recs: 1) calendar RSVP w/ auto-ical 2) two reminders (48h, 2h) 3) one-click reschedule link 4) short cancel flow w/ optional reason

recruitment-bot: RSVP form draft: https://tiny.redwood/rsvp-form (fields: email, timezone, preferred slots, consent). I can collect responses and ping slack.

Leo: Metrics ask — propose: RSVP rate, attended rate, active engagement (first 7 days), onboarding completion. Baseline attended ~50%, target 65% for success.

Marta: Onboarding checklist for DPs: quickstart guide, 30-min kickoff, 3 example prompts, contact channel, sample evals. We should QA these before invites go out.

Alex: Next steps: I'll draft 3 invite variants (Concise, Value-first, Technical-deep) + control. Draft SLA: slot held 72h after RSVP, auto-release on no-show. Can folks review by EOD Fri?

Sam: I can write incentive copy (credits + optional private session). Want A/B variant for incentives too.

Jin: I'll wire reminders + reschedule flow. Need final copy for 48h and 2h reminders.

Leo: I'll add a metrics tile to the DP dashboard and set alerts for attended_rate < 60%.

Alex: Pilot plan: 2-week pilot, n=40 invites (randomized across variants). Success criteria: attended >= 65% AND 7-day engagement up >= 20% vs baseline -> scale.

Marta: + track cancellation reasons (short picklist) and test cancellation friction (extra step vs single-tap).

Alex: Good call. Add an optional 2-question exit survey after cancel: reason + follow-up interest.

Sam: I'll share credit redemption flow + legal blurb by tomorrow.

Jin: When drafts are ready post-review, I can deploy reminders. ETA for full flow to prod: next Wed if copy locked today.

Leo: I'll prep dashboard and share a mock by EOD Mon.

Alex: Thanks everyone — we'll run the pilot, regroup with results & lessons learned in the DP channel after week 2. :rocket:
